cards.en: Can you recommend a bakery nearby?
cards.ja: 近くのパン屋をおすすめしていただけますか。
cards.glossEn: Can you recommend a bakery nearby?

cards.en: How do I get there on foot from here?
cards.ja: ここから歩いてどう行けばいいですか。
cards.glossEn: How do I get there on foot from here?

cards.ja: もう一度言っていただけますか。

reader.en: It is 6:30 in the morning and Ana is looking for breakfast near the hotel.
reader.ja: 朝の6時半です。アナはホテルの近くで朝食を探しています。
reader.glossEn: It is 6:30 in the morning and Ana is looking for breakfast near the hotel.

reader.en: Ana asks the receptionist: Can you recommend a bakery nearby that is open before 7?
reader.ja: アナはホテルのフロント係に尋ねます。「7時前に開いている近くのパン屋をおすすめしていただけますか。」
reader.glossEn: Ana asks the receptionist: Can you recommend a bakery nearby that is open before 7?

reader.en: The receptionist says: I recommend Panadería Lupita, because the sweet bread comes out hot very early.
reader.ja: フロント係は言います。「Panadería Lupitaをおすすめします。菓子パンが朝早くから温かい状態で出てくるからです。」
reader.glossEn: The receptionist says: I recommend Panadería Lupita, because the sweet bread comes out hot very early.

reader.en: Ana asks: What time does it open?
reader.ja: アナは尋ねます。「何時に開きますか。」
reader.glossEn: Ana asks: What time does it open?

reader.en: He answers: According to their hours, it opens at 6, but on Sundays it opens later.
reader.ja: 彼は答えます。「営業時間によると6時に開きますが、日曜日はもっと遅く開きます。」
reader.glossEn: He answers: According to their hours, it opens at 6, but on Sundays it opens later.

reader.en: Then Ana asks: How do I get there on foot from here?
reader.ja: それからアナは尋ねます。「ここから歩いてどう行けばいいですか。」
reader.glossEn: Then Ana asks: How do I get there on foot from here?

reader.en: The receptionist shows her the map and says: Walk 3 blocks along this street and turn right at the traffic light.
reader.ja: フロント係はアナに地図を見せて言います。「この通りを3ブロック歩き、信号を右に曲がってください。」
reader.glossEn: The receptionist shows her the map and says: Walk 3 blocks along this street and turn right at the traffic light.

reader.en: Ana does not understand everything and asks: Can you repeat that, please?
reader.ja: アナは全部は理解できず、尋ねます。「もう一度言っていただけますか。」
reader.glossEn: Ana does not understand everything and asks: Can you repeat that, please?

reader.en: He calmly repeats: The bakery is on the corner, across from the square.
reader.ja: 彼は落ち着いて繰り返します。「パン屋は街角にあり、広場の向かいです。」
reader.glossEn: He calmly repeats: The bakery is on the corner, across from the square.

issues.note: Receptionist is specifically a hotel front-desk person here. ホテルのフロント係 retains that context; qualified reviewer should confirm register and role term.

Mexican pan dulce denotes a range of sweet bakery pastries. 菓子パン is a contextual candidate; verify culinary/locale nuance and whether the source proper name Panadería Lupita should appear in Japanese script.
Cuadra is a Latin American city block; 街区 on the card and 3ブロック in walking directions need a coherent Japanese dictionary/teaching decision.

The source starts at 6:30, says opens at 6 according to posted hours, but opens later on Sundays. It does not specify whether today is Sunday; the candidate does not claim the bakery is open now on Sundays.
Source gives three blocks along this street and right at the traffic light. Archived draft says second traffic light; that detail is retired, not imported.
The bakery is at the corner across from the square. Archived draft instead asks a map check before leaving. Candidate retains the source location and omits the added instruction.
Archived 14-card/9-turn scene has different counts, route and hours. Old positions lack explicit row IDs and authorize no saved-item, scoring or audio migration.
Recepcionista, pan dulce, cuadra/manzana and the usted repetition note are Spanish-language facts, retained internally rather than presented as Japanese grammar.
